exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus diagnosis by World Health Organization criteria
outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 1360 pregnant women who delivered at a university hospital in Istanbul
finding: In pregnant women younger than 35 years without apparent risk factors for gestational diabetes mellitus, diagnosis and treatment of gestational diabetes mellitus using the World Health Organization criteria was associated with a higher risk of cesarean section, preterm delivery, and neonatal intensive care unit admission, but not neonatal respiratory problems.
